claims.quote: to start a gradual and flexible return of the 2.2 million barrels per day voluntary adjustments starting from 1 April 2025
the eight participating countries will implement a production adjustment of 411 thousand barrels per day, equivalent to three monthly increments, in May 2025
The gradual increases may be paused or reversed subject to evolving market conditions.
They also confirmed their intention to fully compensate any overproduced volume since January 2024 and to submit updated front-loaded compensation plans to the OPEC Secretariat by 15 April 2025
The eight countries will meet on the 5th of May to decide on June production levels.
